title: Kiritani Haruka — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Haruka's birthday
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be over here off-camera!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you.
se_walk_women_006_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, here goes.
Five, four, three...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
Welcome to my special birthday stream!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<We've been waiting!>
<Looking forward to it!>
<Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: First off, let's all wish Haruka a happy birthday together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ready? Go!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Happy birthday!>
<Happy B'day!>
<Have a good one!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you to all our viewers for celebrating with me, too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay! Our first segment is a party game that's sure to get exciting!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We call it “No I In Team: Birthday Edition!”

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! What was that sound?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be playing several games on stream, but if anyone says a word with the letter “I” in it, you'll hear the buzzer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Our manager has the buzzer, so she'll make sure things stay fair.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh. Airi, just now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's sneaky.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're still getting ready, so that isn't actually—

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, instant buzzer! Manager's sharp!>
<Aaaand you're out!>
<This is already fun.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ahem. You see! She's really fast on the draw!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, she'll also track how many times people mess up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, so that's why we're streaming from the office today instead of the streaming room. Because we wanted to use the whiteboard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We did see if we could manage in the streaming room, but it was a bit cramped...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we haven't shown the office off yet! So, here it is! A special reveal!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<So that's why.>
<It's a cute office!>
<Feels cozy.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've gone over the buzzer, let me go over the rest of the rules!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To start, we'll all get some snacks. These are low-carb, so Haruka can enjoy them too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Each snack you have is worth one point.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While we're playing games, every time we break the rule we'll lose a snack. Winning the games is important, but keep an eye on your snack pile too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As an extra bonus, whoever takes home the gold also gets the conf... Um, the snacks everyone lost!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! Wow, Airi!
Nice save—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, we haven't started yet, so that's okay, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, that one gets a pass. But be more careful once we start.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we're starting right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, Minori. Can you tell us what games we'll play?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! To start, we have High or Low!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aaah!!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, the next card's a Queen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, that should be an easy call.
Haruka, what cards are above the Queen? Do you remember?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mm. The father card and the ace.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Father card? You mean the King?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ah... Whoops!
Hey, you set me up!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Too bad.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, Shizuku, you're so good! You're on a streak!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Up or Down's so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, that's the last game finished! No more forbidden words, either!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... That was harder than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You usually never have to think about it when you're talking, after all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, our manager has written down the rankings. Minori, could you read them out for us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, here's how everyone did! In fourth place... Aww, it's me!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Called it.>
<You weren't being very careful, after all.>
<And you did so well in the second game! Too bad.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In third place is... Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?! I thought I earned a lot of points in game 3, though!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wow, really!>
<The High or Low game hurt a bit.>
<Don't feel bad, Airi! It was still fun!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That means it's Haruka and Shizuku left!
Drumroll, please!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Second place goes to... Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right! You win the gold, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Good job, birthday girl!>
<Congrats, Haruka!>
<You were picking up points left and right.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And listen to this. Shizuku and Haruka's scores were so close that in the end, it came down to one snack!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wow, that is super close!>
<Nice fight, Shizuku!>
<That was so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's a shame I didn't win, but I had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Here you go, Haruka. All the snacks that got confiscated are yours now♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks! Though, do we have a bag big enough to carry all these?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, you can carry them home in your tummy.
You could finish them off for sure, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha, that's not a bad idea. But snacks are for after exercise.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll move them to the practice room for later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For what, you might ask?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Here we go!>
<Showtime!>
<The games were so fun I totally forgot!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Today, we're putting on a special show to thank you all for always supporting us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope you'll stay with us to the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's a weird feeling, knowing my whole team knows THE Haruka Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Does it make it less weird knowing she's my best friend?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The friend of a friend is a friend, as they say.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Haruka, I hope we can keep getting to know each other. I'll see you at school, too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Haruka!
Your special stream was so, so good!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki was all, “drop what you're doing and watch this!” and posted the link on Nightcord. It startled me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That was right when the show started. The songs were wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The dancing was cute too, and you all looked radiant. You'd make anyone's heart skip a beat like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Right♪ Now that's what an idol show is meant to be!
I'll always be your fan!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kiritani!
Come on, everyone! Raise your voices in celebration!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haruka! Happy birthdaaaaaay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Careful, you're going to peak the recording!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Kiritani. Um, this is just a voice recording, but Tsukasa and Emu are doing some kind of celebratory dance...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hup! Hah! Even if she can't see us, our passion for celebration will come through!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Happy birthday Haruka♪
Hey! Hoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's an incredibly uncool dance, you two...
Maybe it's better you can't see this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Bands and idols are pretty different things, but it's still heartening knowing you're working as pros, the same as us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah♪ And that special stream was so much fun!
I got goosebumps during your show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was such a powerful performance that I totally forgot it was just your practice room.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It really was amazing. I wanted to leave a comment, but I was so taken I couldn't look away.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Same! I'll have to tell you everything I thought next time I see you at school!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka! Happy birthday! Happy, happy, happy, happy, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How many “happy”s do you need?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Since everyone else is recording too, I wanted to be sure my message was the happiest!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Actually, I haven't said it enough yet.
Haruka, happy, happy, happy, happy—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I won't fall behind, then.
Haruka, happy, happy, happy, happy—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, don't go along with it! Besides, you can just do this in person! Come on, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for all the birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your support does reach me. It gives me strength every day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even now, when I close my eyes, I can feel your warm wishes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This SEKAI is overflowing with feelings, after all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: With these warm feelings supporting me, I promise to keep bringing you the courage to try your best, and to treasure every single day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Haruka Kiritani, signing out♪
See you again!
